full_judgment: "Mr AJ Mohammad Ali, the learned Counsel appearing for the petitioners, firstly contended that having regard to the provisions of sections 6 and 7 of the Registration Act, permitting a Sub-Registrar perform the duties of a Registrar, the Court below including the High Court Division committed an error of law in discarding the registered documents on the mere plea of different Sub-registry registering the documents against the presumption of law that the official acts are duly performed and in such view of the matter, the findings and decisions of the High Court Division cannot be sustained in law. Mr Mohammad Ali next contended that the instant suit being a suit for setting aside ex-parte decree on the ground of fraud and the trial court having clearly found that the suit in which the ex-parte decree was obtained was incompetent, the courts below including the High Court Division erred in law in holding that the present suit was not maintainable at the instance of the plaintiffs."
